description: Forty independently usable agent skills for project writing, product narrative, developer adoption, commercial research and consistent project meaning.

interface.shortDescription: Project writing, architecture and product skills
interface.longDescription: Geekist's 13 authored skills help with project language, architecture, tasks, reports, technical docs, UX copy, product communication and professional outreach. 27 independently usable upstream skills add further options for storytelling, README craft, editing and developer adoption. Choose each skill for the task at hand; combine skills when the work benefits from more than one perspective.
defaultPrompt: Turn these requirements into an actionable implementation task with acceptance criteria.
Explain this system in a README section for a new contributor.
Review this draft for clarity, flow and consistent terminology.
Clarify the domain terms in this codebase and make a concise glossary.
Write clear UI messages for these product states.
Research this company for credible collaboration or paid-work opportunities.
